create_scorer_for_bleu: create a Scorer instance with pad, eos, and unk token IDs to compute BLEU scores
add_reference_prediction_pair: add a reference and prediction torch.IntTensor pair to the Scorer for BLEU evaluation
compute_bleu_score: compute the BLEU score from accumulated reference and prediction pairs using Scorer.score
get_bleu_precision: get the n-gram precision ratios for orders 1 through 4 from the Scorer
score_with_sacrebleu: create a SacrebleuScorer to add string pairs and compute corpus BLEU via sacrebleu
